name: Sit-Down Lunch Spiced Layer Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Soft baked grated carrot sponge with tangy cream cheese frosting, though walnut pieces or raisins must be picked out.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Inspect for and remove any chopped walnuts or raisins, and take a Lactaid pill for the cream cheese icing.
watchOuts: Possible chopped walnuts or raisins in batter
